# Respiratory Risk Report


### Week ending in October 31, 2026


[Kait Hess Jimenez, MS](https://substack.com/@kaithessjimenez)


Nov 06, 2026


Biobot’s national wastewater network shows that Covid has stabilized nationally compared to last week, following an unusual pattern this year. As we discussed last week, covid typically decreases following a summer wave and ahead of a winter wave. However, this year covid has persisted through much of the fall following the summer wave. It will be interesting to watch in the coming weeks if covid decreases following the current plateau or if we will continue to increase as we inch closer to winter.


Flu A continues to rise nationally across all four regions. RSV and flu B remain at very low levels, while HMPV remains at a low level.


**Bottom line**


Covid is still circulating at elevated levels but is fluctuating, while flu A is increasing. As we head further into the season, we can expect flu transmission to continue increasing, while it remains unclear what’s ahead for Covid.


If you haven’t yet, there is still time to schedule your fall vaccines. Which vaccines are recommended depends on your age, health history, and risk factors, so check with your healthcare provider. Most are also available at pharmacies.


---


### **National Outlook**


#### **COVID-19**


Nationally, SARS-CoV-2 is fluctuating.


#### **Influenza**


Nationally, influenza A is increasing, while influenza B is holding steady at very low levels.


#### **RSV**


Nationally, RSV is increasing.


#### **HMPV**


Nationally, HMPV is decreasing and remains low.


---


### **Regional Outlook**


#### **The South**


**COVID-19:** SARS-CoV-2 is fluctuating.


**Influenza:** Influenza A is increasing, while influenza B is holding steady at very low levels.


**RSV:** RSV is increasing.


**HMPV:** HMPV is holding steady.


#### **The Midwest**


**COVID-19** : SARS-CoV-2 is fluctuating.


**Influenza** : Influenza A is increasing, while influenza B is holding steady at very low levels.


**RSV** : RSV is increasing.


**HMPV:** HMPV is decreasing.


#### **The Northeast**


**COVID-19:** SARS-CoV-2 is fluctuating.


**RSV:** RSV is increasing.


**HMPV:** HMPV is decreasing.


#### **The West**


**COVID-19:** SARS-CoV-2 is decreasing.


**RSV:** RSV is increasing.


**HMPV:** HMPV is decreasing.
